responsibility: Small GCC-backend bridge file that exposes backend services needed directly by the Go frontend proper. It reports whether GCC has already emitted errors, computes backend field alignment rules for Go struct layout, disables strict aliasing when the Go `unsafe` package is imported, and implements writing and reading Go export data in object files via a dedicated section/segment (`.go_export` / `__GNU_GO`) using GCC section APIs and `simple-object` readers.
